After Gil and Molly meet a conductor, the Guppies want to join an orchestra.

When reckless hyena Spotty steals young elephant Eli from the savanna, Wildlife Rangers Zooli and Goby hop into their big rig to rescue him; when the big rig chase lands Spotty and Eli in danger, it's up to the Guppies to save the day.

Deema must turn over a new leaf and try broccoli if she wants to earn her broccoli badge at scout troop initiation.

When showman Gil's real live dragon (actually a Komodo dragon) gets loose in the small town of Bubbleville, it's up to Pet Finders Oona and Zooli to track the lizard down and return it to its home on Komodo Island.

Excited that Zooli is getting a new pet, the Guppies try to guess what kind of animal it is; Zooli loves many creatures, so her new pet could be anything in the animal kingdom.

Gil and his friends dive into Gil's favorite books to find his missing library card.
